notes.title: Dev Diary: Heroes of the Citadel
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831671/ffd6f8b0e6e16d7f6664e10e8a3f723601e2b439.png[/img]

[h1][b]Dev Diary: Heroes of the Citadel
[/b][/h1]

[h2]Latest Updates from Heroes of the Citadel: Developing Raid Boss Events and Survival Mode![/h2]ːsteamhappyː

Welcome to our Dev Diary series! In each edition, we’ll put you directly in contact with the developers working on each Funtico game. 

We hope you enjoy the insider view of what our team is working on!

Dear Heroes,

We are excited to share progress on the development of two thrilling new features soon to come in "Heroes of the Citadel"! These updates are currently under active development, and we want to give you a sneak peek at what we are working on to enhance your gaming experience once you dive into our fantasy world.

[h2]Raid Boss Event: A New Challenge![/h2]

Our upcoming Raid Boss Event will offer you new exciting challenges. Once you reach a certain level, the Raid Boss icon will appear on your main screen, giving you the opportunity to challenge Bosses in a unique environment for special rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831671/e6b69fd880591c2171f8d4ac270acd602705e604.png[/img]

This timed event will reward those who are able to emerge victorious with exclusive items and skins to wear as a badge of honor!. But, beware! Each boss will have a special condition that changes with each event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831671/e3aceb38850d739be2c26d4aa0ae50727a87d06b.png[/img]

[h2]Survival Mode: Endless Adventure![/h2]

In the developing Survival Mode, endless waves of enemies await you. Available after reaching the required level, this mode will challenge the limits of your endurance with a continuous flow of increasingly difficult opponents. 

Fight against time and foes to claim your place among the legends of the Citadel. Rewards will increase with each wave you overcome, providing not only coins but also a chance to obtain unique skins and other valuable items.

[h2]Development Process[/h2]

We are in the process of setting up the timers and restart conditions for these events to ensure the most engaging and dynamic gameplay for you. All these innovations are being implemented with the goal of enriching your gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831671/a9e830fdd243ba145c1675a992f516c4d6543eda.png[/img]

Stay Updated

These new features are still in development, and we plan to launch them in the near future. Join our community on Discord to discuss these updates and share your thoughts on the new additions. 

Thank you for actively participating in our gaming community. We can’t wait to get you into  "Heroes of the Citadel" and start adventuring!

If you’re chomping at the bit as much as we are to dive into Heroes of the Citadel, wishlist us on Steam today so that you’re ready as soon as a playable version drops!

Looking forward to seeing you in the game,
The Heroes of the Citadel Team
